population.kidComparison: About 34 million people live here—roughly the same population as California.

geography.climate: Dry desert along the Pacific coast, cool high mountains in the Andes, and hot, rainy tropical rainforest in the Amazon basin.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Three vertical bands of red, white, and red.

anthem.title: Himno Nacional del Perú
anthem.summary: Composed in 1821 to celebrate Peru's independence.

exploration.didYouKnow: Potatoes were first domesticated in the Andes Mountains of Peru thousands of years ago—there are over 3,000 varieties there today!

regionalTraits: Wears a brightly patterned woven Andean scarf
Always carries roasted corn snacks in their coat pocket
Speaks fluently about ancient Inca stone masonry
